notes.title: RELEASE SLAPPY BOARD!
notes.notes:
📢 It's here! Today marks the official release of Slappy Board! Get ready to immerse yourself in the ultimate virtual slapping experience.

Grab your VR headset, step out of the elevator and let the slapping games commence!👋 Slappy Board is now available for purchase.

Thank you for all the support up to this point. Slap away to your heart's content! 🥽

Join our discord and share your passion and the amount of slaps you did in your playthrough! 
https://discord.gg/q64zxAMB

Have fun playing!

Team Slappy Inc.

notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
Great news and a big milestone for us, as we finally have a release date for our game Slappy Board!
 
Mark your calenders on the 15th of November, as Slappy Board will be available on Steam.

Be sure to add to your wishlist and follow us for all the latest updates as we work on the finishing touches of our game. 

Discord:
https://discord.gg/cTBgzZDp5d


Until then!
Team Slappy Inc.

notes.title: Slappy Board Demo VR input bugfix
notes.notes:
VR bugfix

We received some feedback that there was an issue with the Index controllers. 
We resolved the problem, but if you still get an error when launching our Demo about a not found action manifest. Please verify the game files through de game properties in your Steam library.

Keep on slapping!
